paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата илюстрира сравнение на изчислителните разходи, измерени в FLOPS, за различни подходи за дообучение на езикови модели.  Хоризонталната ос представлява различните методи за дообучение, включващи "Full FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "MTL-FT", "QLoRA", "LoRA-FT" и "Ours", подредени произволно. Вертикалната ос представлява броя на FLOPS, показан в логаритмична скала от 10^18 до 10^20, с интервал от 1. Променливата на оста е обозначена с "# FLOPS".  Височината на стълбовете показва стойностите на FLOPS за всеки метод. Например, "Full FT" има приблизително 10^19 FLOPS, докато "Ours" показва стойност около 10^18 FLOPS. Стълбовете са оцветени в жълто и зелено, като "Ours" е изобразен в различен зелен цвят. Няма визуални детайли, които да подчертават определени стълбове, нито е видно, че стойностите са подредени по модел.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the computational cost, measured in FLOPs, for various fine-tuning methods applied to a language model. The horizontal axis displays the names of different methods, including "Full FT," "TAG," "LoRA," "MTL-FT", "QLoRA," and "Ours," presented at a 45-degree angle. The vertical axis, labeled "# FLOPs," utilizes a logarithmic scale (base 10), ranging from 10<sup>18</sup> to 10<sup>20</sup>, with tick labels at 10<sup>18</sup>, 10<sup>19</sup>, and 10<sup>20</sup>. The bars representing the computational cost are colored in shades of orange and green. "Full FT" has an approximate value of 1.3 x 10<sup>20</sup> FLOPs, while "TAG" is approximately 1.1 x 10<sup>20</sup> FLOPs, “LoRA” is approximately 8.5 x 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs, "MTL-FT" is approximately 7.5 x 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs, “QLoRA” is approximately 5.3 x 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs, and "Ours" is represented by a green bar with an approximate value of 1.0 x 10<sup>19</sup> FLOPs. The bars are sorted in descending order from left to right, reflecting a decreasing computational cost. The "Ours" bar is visually distinguished with a green color and appears to be the shortest bar in the set.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Anzahl der FLOPs für verschiedene Methoden beim Feintuning von Sprachmodellen. Die horizontale Achse zeigt sechs verschiedene Methoden: Full FT, TAG, LoRA, MTL-FT, QLoRA und Ours, die in alphabetischer Reihenfolge angeordnet sind. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Anzahl der FLOPs dar, wobei die Skala logarithmisch ist und Werte von 10^18 bis 10^20 abdeckt, mit Tick-Beschriftungen, die bei 10^18, 10^19 und 10^20 platziert sind. Die Balken sind in einer Farbe dargestellt, wobei die Methoden Full FT, TAG, LoRA und QLoRA in Gelb dargestellt sind, MTL-FT in einer schattierten gelben Farbe und Ours in Grün dargestellt sind. Der Balken für Full FT entspricht etwa 10^20 FLOPs, der Balken für TAG etwa 10^19,7 FLOPs, der Balken für LoRA etwa 10^19,5 FLOPs, der Balken für MTL-FT etwa 10^19,3 FLOPs, der Balken für QLoRA etwa 10^19 FLOPs und der Balken für Ours etwa 10^18,7 FLOPs. Der Balken für Ours ist visuell hervorgehoben.
